fill_reason.pin_bound: Die frame 3240 x 3672 (q2o1 SU slot, Q-COMPUTE-DIE option (a), 2026-10-16) holds 256 hard children (4.84 mm2) in an 8x8 lane grid at 388.8 x 432 (43.2-um child lattice) pitch spread over the whole slot (no empty quadrant); the 26,025 data pins on three faces (S 8,511 / W 8,057 / E 7,405 at <= 10.4 pins/um/layer) and the face pin registers set the edges.

structural_change: Hardened qfd_sp_su64_sfu (die master, PINREG=1): 64 x (CROM5 lane head crom5_f + exp/rcp/rsq native45), every pin registered (va/ca/xsw/sd/cp pin registers; SU requests/writes keep their far-pin edge via RD-1 lane request relays + align EML 1), 256 hard-child clock entries as interior M7 pins over each child clock pin, 90 standard-cell CTS roots (ck, ck_lane x64, ck_align x16, ck_red x9; vred soft, its closed views fail the native audit).  Schedule deltas: results/rtl/qwen_su64_pinreg_1016/schedule_delta.json.

reroute_reason.why: First hardened SU parent; replaces the generated q2o1 frame. PINREG removes the comb pin->pin arcs (external_vm_a->va, si stage->ca) and registers va/xsw/sd/cp.
